items.title: Exact Gaussian means on the midpoint cosine spectrum

source.anchor: A3.Ex138; A3.SS3.p5.1/Ex141–143; p6.1,p6.2/Ex144–147. Standing S4.SS1.p1.1/S4.E11/S4.Thmtheorem5.p1.1. Private consumer p8.2,p9.1/Ex150.
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling.
source.scope: Exact actual Gaussian means in Fact C8 and an actual private mean-upper-bound/normalized bias identity; variance and further bias estimates excluded.

items.statement: The actual Gaussian on the midpoint cosine spectrum has the following two exact means. Both integrands are integrable. M=\mathbb E\|U\|^2=\frac d{\sqrt\kappa}\frac{1-r^{2d}}{1+r^{2d}},\qquad(-1)^n\mu_n=(-1)^n\mathbb E[U^\top D_nU]=\frac d{\sqrt\kappa}\frac{r^n-r^{2d-n}}{1+r^{2d}}. Fix \(d\in\mathbb N\), \(d\ge2\), \(\kappa\in\mathbb R\), \(\kappa\ge2\), and \(n\in\mathbb N\) with \(1\le n<d\). For \(i=1,\ldots,d\), set \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(\lambda_i=(\kappa+1)/2+((\kappa-1)/2)\cos\theta_i\), and \(\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_i)\). Lean uses \(i\in\mathrm{Fin}\,d\) and \((i.\mathrm{val}+1/2)\pi/d\). Let \(U\sim N(0,\Lambda^{-1})\) on real Euclidean space and \(D_n=\operatorname{diag}(\cos(n\theta_i))\). The literal Gaussian constructor takes covariance \(\Lambda^{-1}\); \(\Lambda\) is precision. Its coordinate quadratic form is \(Q(x)=\sum_i\cos(n\theta_i)x_i^2\). Set \(r=(\sqrt\kappa-1)/(\sqrt\kappa+1)\), \(M=\int\|x\|^2\,d\mu\), and \(\mu_n=\int Q(x)\,d\mu\), where \(\mu=N(0,\Lambda^{-1})\). The inequalities \(0<r<1\), all denominator conditions and both integrability facts are proved internally.
assumptions: Fix \(d\in\mathbb N\), \(d\ge2\), \(\kappa\in\mathbb R\), \(\kappa\ge2\), and \(n\in\mathbb N\) with \(1\le n<d\).

For \(i=1,\ldots,d\), set \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(\lambda_i=(\kappa+1)/2+((\kappa-1)/2)\cos\theta_i\), and \(\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_i)\). Lean uses \(i\in\mathrm{Fin}\,d\) and \((i.\mathrm{val}+1/2)\pi/d\).

Let \(U\sim N(0,\Lambda^{-1})\) on real Euclidean space and \(D_n=\operatorname{diag}(\cos(n\theta_i))\). The literal Gaussian constructor takes covariance \(\Lambda^{-1}\); \(\Lambda\) is precision. Its coordinate quadratic form is \(Q(x)=\sum_i\cos(n\theta_i)x_i^2\).

Set \(r=(\sqrt\kappa-1)/(\sqrt\kappa+1)\), \(M=\int\|x\|^2\,d\mu\), and \(\mu_n=\int Q(x)\,d\mu\), where \(\mu=N(0,\Lambda^{-1})\). The inequalities \(0<r<1\), all denominator conditions and both integrability facts are proved internally.

obligations.label: Actual norm-square Gaussian integral has the first closed C8 value.
Actual signed cosine-quadratic Gaussian integral has the second closed C8 value.
Both actual Gaussian integrands are integrable.

bindings.boundary: This packet proves only the actual closed Fact C.8 mean formulas, integrability and a genuine private normalized-bias/mean-upper-bound consumer. Fourth moments, independence/variances, logarithmic/exponential bias estimates, orthogonal target transport, Krylov and adaptive algorithm/output laws remain open. Exact oracle, TV precision, deterministic worst-case query caps, explicit expected-cost adapters and both full main lower bounds remain open. Independent source verification, serialized integration, desktop/mobile/graph acceptance, remote publication and purification/Exposition Seal are separate stages.

assumption_deltas.source: d≥2, κ≥2 and integer1≤n<d in the fixed cosine hard family.
assumption_deltas.lean: Exactly d:Nat, hd:2≤d, κ:Real, hκ:2≤κ, n:Nat, hn:1≤n, hnd:n<d.
assumption_deltas.reason: No oddness, d−n≥sqrtκ, query condition, summability, positivity, moment certificate or denominator input is added.

assumption_deltas.source: U is the centered Gaussian with diagonal inverse-precision covariance; its two quadratic means are the source quantities.
assumption_deltas.lean: Literal multivariateGaussian0 Λ inverse on EuclideanSpace, actual norm-square integral and literal coordinate diagonal quadratic integral.
assumption_deltas.reason: The Gaussian constructor takes covariance; the canonical GaussianMoments proof establishes actual positive definiteness and inversion. Q is the ordinary diagonal quadratic form, never defined by its mean.

assumption_deltas.source: C7, finite aliases and the three supported positive-frequency classes evaluate the actual means.
assumption_deltas.lean: Internal absolute convergence, finite-grid/tsum exchange, injective and exhaustive support reindexing, both tails, Int shifts and parity arithmetic.
assumption_deltas.reason: These proof ingredients are discharged inside the producer. Negative shifted modes are preserved by Int subtraction and the source singleton is the a=0 term, rather than an assumed counting identity.

assumption_deltas.source: Expectation notation presupposes integrability and geometric expressions have their intended denominators.
assumption_deltas.lean: Both Integrable assertions are outputs; 0<r<1 and every denominator condition are internal.
assumption_deltas.reason: This rules out default-zero Bochner integrals or totalized inverse shortcuts. No analytic certificate becomes a public premise.

assumption_deltas.source: The two means imply the p8.2 mean upper bound and p9/Ex150 absolute bias ratio.
assumption_deltas.lean: Private actual-Gaussian consumer derives positive m, m≤d/sqrtκ, signed b>0 and the exact ratio using both new output equalities.
assumption_deltas.reason: The consumer has the same original family hypotheses. Variance/fourth moments and later exponential estimates are not invoked or credited.
